categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai MicroPort Endovascular MedTech (Group) Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of high-end medical devices focused on aortic and peripheral vascular interventional medical devices. The company’s main product lines include aortic covered stent systems, peripheral balloon dilation catheters, peripheral vascular stent systems, embolization coils, vena cava filters, filter retrievers, and intraoperative stent systems. It also engages in tumor intervention devices through peripheral vascular intervention. The company has a comprehensive product portfolio covering aortic, peripheral arterial and venous, intraoperative, and tumor intervention medical devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies in the design and manufacturing of covered stent systems for aortic diseases, including patented technologies such as branch stent fabrication, ultra-low profile delivery systems, multi-branch stent release techniques, laser engraving for precision stent formation, and drug coating technologies for sustained release. It also develops advanced catheter and filter technologies with proprietary designs for embolization, thrombectomy, and vascular support. Production strictly adheres to medical device quality management standards (YY/T0287-2017, ISO13485:2016) and employs advanced manufacturing equipment for stents and balloon catheters, ensuring high product quality and reliability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves hospitals and medical institutions primarily in China, covering over 2400 hospitals domestically, including tier-2, tier-3, and county-level hospitals. It targets cardiovascular and peripheral vascular disease patients requiring interventional treatments. Internationally, it markets products in over 40 countries across Europe, Latin America, and Asia-Pacific regions. Key customers include hospitals performing aortic and peripheral vascular interventions, with sales mainly through a buyout distribution model involving distributors and medical institutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with extensive coverage across all 31 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities. It has expanded its international presence to over 40 countries including Colombia, Greece, Belgium, South Korea, Uzbekistan, Belarus, Brazil, and others. It has subsidiaries and sales offices in Europe, the United States, and Hong Kong, supporting global market development and regulatory approvals such as CE and FDA certifications.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai MicroPort Endovascular MedTech operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the medical device supply chain. It is engaged in the R&D, manufacturing, and sales of high-end interventional medical devices. The company manages procurement of raw materials, production, quality control, and distribution through a network of distributors to hospitals, positioning itself as a comprehensive medical device manufacturer and supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on continuous innovation and R&D in aortic and peripheral vascular intervention devices, aiming to lead the global market. It emphasizes developing products with independent intellectual property rights, including multi-branch aortic stents, drug-coated balloons, and novel embolization devices. The company invests heavily in clinical trials, regulatory approvals (including NMPA’s innovative device green channel), and overseas registrations (CE, FDA). It also focuses on expanding tumor intervention product lines and enhancing product portfolios to address complex clinical needs.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of medical devices, including aortic stents, peripheral vascular devices, and tumor intervention products. The company sells mainly via a buyout distribution model to distributors who then supply hospitals and medical institutions. It also has direct sales in some international markets. Revenue recognition occurs when control of products transfers to customers, typically upon delivery or customs clearance for exports.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the aortic and peripheral vascular interventional medical device market in China, with a dominant market share in aortic intervention devices. Major international competitors include Medtronic, Boston Scientific, Abbott, and Gore. While international companies hold significant shares in peripheral vascular devices, Shanghai MicroPort Endovascular MedTech is rapidly expanding its product portfolio and market presence, achieving import substitution and competing effectively on technology and price.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.206 billion, representing a 1.61% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 502 million, up 1.96%. The company’s total assets stood at RMB 4.29 billion with net assets of RMB 3.79 billion. Overseas sales nearly doubled to over RMB 160 million, accounting for more than 13% of total revenue. R&D investment accounted for 14.05% of revenue, reflecting a strategic emphasis on innovation despite a reduction in absolute R&D spending compared to the prior year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes providing accessible, high-quality, and innovative medical solutions for blood circulation diseases, focusing on products with independent intellectual property and advanced technology. It offers the first domestically developed and globally competitive branch-type aortic covered stent system, ultra-low profile delivery systems, and drug-coated balloons that reduce restenosis. Its products are recognized for clinical efficacy, safety, and cost-effectiveness, contributing to import substitution and reducing patient and healthcare system burdens. The company also supports clinical education and academic exchange to enhance product adoption and clinical outcomes.
